text_block_list.text: During training one day—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*... *phew*...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You're really focused, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Grandmother is coming
to watch your next race, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, which is why I intend to show her
my absolute best race, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Geez! Why did you even come to cheer for me?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: My... whatever could be the matter?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl's Mother
text_block_list.text: Sweetheart, you said today was an important race...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Today's mock race has tons of trainers
coming to watch!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
So if Mom is watching, um...
I'll be too embarrassed to run!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I see... I'm sorry. In that case,
Mom will head home, so do your best in the race, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: What's up with that... Did they have a fight?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
An official race is one thing, but coming all the way
to the academy just to watch... She seems like a wonderful mother to me, though...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hey, should we go talk to her?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, let us, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Excuse us.
Did something happen with your mom?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Ah, um...
She came to cheer just because it's my mock race...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
But... with Mom there,
it's like I can't run properly...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Can't run properly...?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
L-Look...!
It's just embarrassing! Somehow!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Because your mother cheering is embarrassing...
Is that truly the case?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Deep down, you are terrified
of failing to live up to her expectations, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However, your mother is your very first fan,
and the fan who supports you more than anyone else in the world, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Even if the results fall short of expectations,
there is no chance she will ever be disappointed in you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Rather than worrying, let your mother see
your absolute utmost effort right now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That is what it means to "answer your fans", desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: ...My... number one fan...!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Um, thank you so much!
Mom, waaaaait for meeee!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... She will surely put on
a magnificent race for her mother, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now, I must do my best as well!
Let us continue training, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you'll be able to show Grandmother
your best race too, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, naturally.
Expectations are not pressure, but strength, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now then, I shall continue my training...
(Grummmmblllleeeeee~~...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Holding back on food is forbidden
if you want to show Grandmother your best race, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ugh... That felt quite unbefitting, desu wa...
